$Comment: Martha the Cook's look, every piece of it the game's own: the player's body and an older face, long grey hair under a straw hat, the character creator's apron dress over a farmer's shirt, plain brown trousers and brown boots. Parent Seasons_Of_Orbis_Villager brings the player's body, its animations and its hitbox, as Parent Player does for the temple's own Mithril Guard, and the wave she greets a player with. The body, face, mouth and ears share one skin tone (GradientSet Skin, GradientId 02): change all four together. DefaultAttachments replaces the parent's list whole, so the face pieces come first. Under a hat the character creator swaps a haircut for its generic one (HaircutFallbacks), so the hair here is GenericLong, as a player's long hair looks under the straw hat. The apron dress is the creator's OnePiece_ApronDress overtop: the OnePiece model with its ApronDress texture, dyed from Pastel_Cotton, the set the creator offers it in. A greyscale texture takes its colour from GradientSet and GradientId, the dyes the character creator offers players: change a GradientId to re-dye one piece.
